mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This appears to be a peeled orange, a whole fruit that provides natural carbohydrates along with fiber and water. Its glycemic impact is generally mild to moderate for someone with diabetes compared with refined sweets, though portion size still affects blood sugar levels. It is best to choose whole fruit like this over fruit juice or sweetened fruit products, opting for high-fiber whole fruit instead.
